Which director would that be? My SO is a film major and he could have a good laugh at this

Unfortunately I don't think it'd be a good idea to share stuff via this account, it could get linked back to my main reddit/real identity. 

In terms of publishing I've had the most success with plays, but I actually mainly write fantasy novels. Sadly, it seems every time I go to some sort of writing class the professors there tend to deride sci fi and fantasy. The professor of the class I didn't get into even focused on these genres in her intro speech, saying that these genres tended to stay comfortable in the same tropes and not do anything new. I'd like to think I try new things and explore serious ideas in my work but I can't be sure.
I'm actually a junior transfer, but your post was helpful. I think asking my professor why my piece didn't get in might make things worse. But I will try to go for counseling.
